extension.description: Compare any two git revisions like a pull request's Files changed, plus the full history of a single file: file tree, split view, word diff and syntax highlighting.
command.compareRevisions.title: Compare Revisions…
command.fileHistory.title: File History…
command.stashes.title: Stashes…
configuration.contextLines.description: How many context lines to show around changes.
configuration.collapseFilesOverLines.des: Files whose diff is longer than this many lines start collapsed. 0 — never collapse.
configuration.defaultViewMode.descriptio: Diff layout a panel opens with.
configuration.defaultViewMode.unified: One column, added and removed lines in sequence
configuration.defaultViewMode.split: Two columns: base revision on the left, compared revision on the right
